decisions.reason: Although this newer consumer-facing item appears less central and less visibly committed than the firm's plant technologies, it is still very recent and management inclined to justify its launch would likely give it more time.

As a multi-model extension line built directly on the firm's established waste-to-energy business, it reflects substantial investment and strategic commitment, which under escalation of commitment strongly favors continuation.
This plant is closely tied to the firm's core technology offer and was important enough to receive its own web page, signaling visible commitment and making withdrawal within a year unlikely.

Even if this product is somewhat less embedded than the core offer, it still fits the firm's announced sustainable waste-to-fuel direction and management can plausibly attribute any weak early uptake to temporary market-development factors.
